Oracle Fusion Logistics (OTM, GTM, WMS) 26D: what's new

26D is the next Oracle Fusion Cloud quarterly update. Oracle's 26D What's New documents for this area list 31 features: 3 on by default, 5 on by default with potential setup, 22 setup required, 0 opt-in, 1 needing another action, per Oracle's "Action to Enable" column. See all 31 →

We track 25 Logistics (OTM, GTM, WMS) changes in 26D, out of 31 features (our count) in Oracle's 26D What's New documents for this area. 8 of them are delivered switched on; 17 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Oracle sources: Warehouse Management 26D What's New

Oracle had not published 26D What's New documents for Global Trade Management (GTM) and Transportation Management (OTM) when we last checked, so they are not included yet. We check every week and add them once Oracle publishes.

Impact on upgrade is our editorial rating of how much a change affects existing users and testing; Oracle scale is Oracle's own rating. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

Former opt-ins now standard in 26D

From Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list: features whose opt-in period ends with 26D. If you already opted in and finished setup, nothing changes. All former opt-ins now standard in 26D →

None in Oracle's list.

Delivered switched on (8)

Control active location scan in pick cart

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Logistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Outbound LogisticsIdea Lab
You can now configure whether location confirmation is required when picking from an active location using Pick Cart. This helps high-volume operations reduce mobile scans when active locations are already controlled through the item scan and location display.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Customer and ship-to search fields in the Redwood outbound container UI

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Redwood Mobile WMSIdea Lab
WMS adds more custom and ship-to details to the Redwood Outbound Container UI. This helps users find outbound containers faster by searching with information from the related order.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Enhanced configuration migration safeguards and lock code handling

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Logistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · WMS Common
Configuration migration helps users move setup data across facilities and companies without manually recreating configuration records. This enhancement helps customers protect destination setup, maintain 3PL company rules, and keep lock code facility details accurate during configuration import and copy flows.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Expand mobile Load LPN transaction to honor load related facility parameters

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Logistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Redwood Mobile WMSIdea Lab
In 26D, WMS honours load close validation in Mobile Load OBLPN transaction. When the facility parameter ASSIGN_NEWLOAD_AT_CLOSE is set to No , users cannot close a load from Mobile if assigned OBLPNs are not loaded.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Search wave group inquiry by wave group name

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory OperationsIdea Lab
WMS adds Wave Group Name as a search field in Wave Group Inquiry. This helps users quickly find the required wave group without manually reviewing many records.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Support picks from alternate active locations for warehouse automation

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Logistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Outbound LogisticsIdea Lab
Oracle Fusion Cloud Warehouse Management enhances the Pick Confirm API to provide greater flexibility when the inventory originally allocated for an order isn't the inventory available at pick time.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Web Report usage visibility

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · WMS Common
Customers now have greater visibility into Web Report usage, making it easier to understand report activity, analyze execution performance, and troubleshoot long-running reports.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Additional criteria for label template selection rules

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Logistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · WMS Common
WMS adds more fields to Label Template Selection Rules so customers can print the right outbound labels based on task, allocation, order, and order detail information.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Needs setup or opt-in (17)

3D warehouse inventory visualizer

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · WMS Common
The new Warehouse Visual Layout feature provides an interactive visual representation of your warehouse based on configured location data, helping warehouse teams understand the physical layout, investigate inventory and operational conditions, and make faster decisions about location capacity and utilization.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

AI Agentic App: Warehouse Execution Command Center

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Cloud SCM IntegrationAgentic app
Warehouse execution requires teams to coordinate receiving, putaway, replenishment, and picking activities. Supervisors need to monitor performance, prioritize work, identify dependencies, and resolve issues to keep operations moving.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Capture number of pallets to be counted

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory Operations
Reserve LPN number count – create detailed counting task The Reserve LPN Number Count ( Resv-LPN Nbr Cnt) Redwood mobile transaction now supports counting either LPNs or pallets.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Control IBLPN and OBLPN custom fields prompt in mobile updates and handling

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Outbound LogisticsIdea Lab
WMS lets administrators control which IBLPN and OBLPN custom fields appear in the Mobile IBLPN Updates and Handling (rf.inbound.cwrfiblpnupdatesandhandling) and Post Packing OBLPN Updates and Handling (rf.outbound.cwrfpostpackinglpnhandling).
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Cycle counting improvements

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory OperationsIdea Lab
Cycle count reviews are now easier to analyze and audit, reducing unnecessary investigation of records where inventory has simply moved between LPNs or locations.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Determine the trigger mode for run wave

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Outbound Logistics
You can now use the Redwood Wave Inquiry screen to see the source screen and module responsible for creating a wave, making it easier to distinguish between waves initiated manually, from template-driven processes, by scheduled jobs, or through REST APIs.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Enable FedEx international processing for Puerto Rico shipments

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Outbound Logistics
Oracle WMS Cloud now supports FedEx International processing requirements for applicable shipments from the mainland United States to Puerto Rico. This enhancement helps prevent FedEx shipment request failures, reduces manual intervention, and minimizes shipping delays by ensuring required customs information is automatically included when Puerto Rico shipments must be processed through the FedEx International shipme…
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Enable reuse of consumed/cancelled LPNs during Mobile Inbound Sorting

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inbound LogisticsIdea Lab
Warehouse operators can now reuse existing carts or trolleys with a Cancelled or Consumed IBLPN status label during Mobile IB Sorting to LPN, avoiding the unnecessary creation of new LPNs and labels.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Enhanced inventory identification and item visibility in Pick and Allocate

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Outbound LogisticsIdea Lab
Pick and Allocate now helps warehouse users identify and pick the correct physical inventory more accurately and efficiently , particularly when the same item exists with different batch, expiry, or inventory attribute values.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Enhanced self-service status recalculation

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · WMS Common
In certain cases, warehouse transactions can leave a record in a status that no longer reflects its underlying task, packing, loading, or receiving activity. These status inconsistencies can prevent downstream processing and previously require a support request or data correction.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Enhancements to SCM Reconciliation workbench for serial tracked items

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Cloud SCM Integration
The SCM Reconciliation Workbench gives warehouse users a centralized place to review integration errors and inventory differences between WMS and ERP Inventory.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Enhancements to stage location configuration

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory OperationsIdea Lab
Warehouse teams can now maintain Stage Location Configuration records more efficiently through integrations and APIs, reducing manual configuration effort and supporting faster, more consistent onboarding and maintenance.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Expanded Redwood experience for desktop

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · WMS CommonRedwood Platform
More screens within WMS Redwood Desktop are now available with the Redwood experience, continuing the modernization of the WMS web interface with improved usability, navigation, and productivity.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Improvements to Redwood Desktop

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · WMS CommonRedwood Platform
Redwood Desktop introduces several usability enhancements that make it easier for users to access frequently used WMS screens, preserve their preferred desktop experience, and work more efficiently with page actions.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Improvements to task-based putaway

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inbound Logistics
Warehouse operators can now use user-driven putaway to select the most accessible LPN or inventory from the cart before being directed to its allocated destination location.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Lock code authorization and contextual filtering by facility and group

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory OperationsIdea Lab
Organizations operating multiple Facilities/Groups often use different Lock Codes for processes such as damaged inventory, quality holds, returns, expired inventory, inventory discrepancies, and other operational controls.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Maintain stop receiving flag through purchase order interfaces

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inbound Logistics
WMS now supports the stop_recv_flg field for Purchase Order detail interfaces and the PO Detail Stage UI. This helps customers stop or resume receiving for a specific PO line without closing or cancelling the full purchase order.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source
